name: hash
doc:
hash: the streaming hash interfaces (Go's hash.Hash, Hash32,
Hash64) implemented by hash.fnv, crc32, crc64, adler32 and
maphash, plus Combine for building hash keys from several values.

items.name: Bytes32
items.doc: Big-endian bytes of x (for Sum of 32-bit hashes).
items.summary: Big-endian bytes of x (for Sum of 32-bit hashes).

items.name: Bytes64
items.doc: Big-endian bytes of x (for Sum of 64-bit hashes).
items.summary: Big-endian bytes of x (for Sum of 64-bit hashes).

items.name: Combine
items.signature: func Combine(h1 uint, h2 uint) uint
items.doc:
Mixes hash h2 into h1 (boost::hash_combine, 64-bit), for hashing
composite keys: Combine(Combine(seed, hash(a)), hash(b)).
items.summary: Mixes hash h2 into h1 (boost::hash_combine, 64-bit), for hashing composite keys: Combine(Combine(seed, hash(a)), hash(b)).
